The accused, who had been on the run since the charge sheet was filed against him in 2001, was apprehended at Lucknow Railway Station around midnight on October 22.

title: Delhi Police Detain Protesters Marching Against Electoral Roll Revision Near Election Commission Office
summary: On Friday, Delhi Police detained several protesters who were marching towards the Election Commission of India headquarters in central Delhi. The demonstration was aimed at opposing the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. Authorities enforced Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, which restricts public gatherings, leading to the march being halted.

title: ‘Vote-Chori’ Is Serious Threat To Democracy; SIR Must Be Scrapped: CM Bhagwant Singh Mann
summary: Chief Minister Bhagwant Singh Mann on Friday said that ‘Vote-Chori’ (vote theft) poses a serious threat to Indian democracy and demanded the scrapping of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, calling for an impartial investigation into the process and strict action against those responsible for irregularities.

title: Mumbai Government Railway Police Participate In PETA India's Workshop To Combat Cruelty To Animals
summary: PETA India conducted an animal cruelty sensitisation workshop for around 100 Mumbai Government Railway Police personnel at GRP Headquarters in Ghatkopar. The training focused on animal protection laws, wildlife trafficking, rescue procedures and investigations. It followed the rescue of 282 birds allegedly transported in overcrowded cages aboard the Geetanjali Express.
